nodes.label: RAWG
nodes.desc: Primary game metadata: games, DLCs, genres, platforms, stores (where to play), Metacritic, screenshots, similar. Free key. Cached (mem + disk, 24h).

nodes.label: Steam
nodes.desc: Library import (owned games + playtime) via the steam-auth Edge Function — "Sign in through Steam" (OpenID). Also store links + CDN header images. Key is a function secret, never in the client.

nodes.label: Supabase
nodes.desc: Cloud backend: Postgres + Auth + Storage + Edge Functions. Default backend (cloud-first; login always required).

nodes.label: TMDB (legacy)
nodes.desc: Vestigial from Watch Hoard. src/tmdb.ts is a shim re-exporting rawg.ts; only the image-URL helper lingers in packages/core.

nodes.label: /episode/[key]
nodes.desc: Legacy episode route from the Watch Hoard base.

nodes.label: /movie/[id]
nodes.desc: Legacy movie route from the Watch Hoard base.

nodes.label: data.ts
nodes.desc: Domain types (mirror the Postgres schema) + demo data.

nodes.label: dates.ts
nodes.desc: Date-only helpers with LOCAL-day semantics.

nodes.label: db/index.ts
nodes.desc: Native (iOS/Android) data source.

nodes.label: db/index.web.ts
nodes.desc: Web data source. Never imports ./local (keeps expo-sqlite out of the web bundle). local (default) -> in-memory (MemorySource); supabase -> cloud (see ./supabase).

nodes.label: db/memory.ts
nodes.desc: Web / SSR fallback: same DataSource contract, backed by the seed JSON held in memory.

nodes.label: db/schema.ts
nodes.desc: Local (on-device) SQLite schema — a pragmatic mirror of the Postgres schema in supabase/migrations.

nodes.label: detail.tsx
nodes.desc: Shared building blocks for the game-detail screen (GamerHoard).

nodes.label: genres.ts
nodes.desc: Library genre support: id<->name maps (localized) + lazy TMDB backfill of the `genres` column (comma-joined TMDB genre ids; '' = resolved but none/unknown).

nodes.label: i18n/en.ts
nodes.desc: English translations (default language).

nodes.label: i18n/es.ts
nodes.desc: Spanish translations. Typed as `Dict` (the shape of en.ts) so tsc flags any missing OR extra key versus English — this is our "nothing left behind" guard.

nodes.label: i18n/index.ts
nodes.desc: i18next setup for Watch Hoard.

nodes.label: img.ts
nodes.desc: Placeholder poster while the real TMDB artwork loads/backfills: a neutral dark tile with the title's initial.

nodes.label: import/csv.ts
nodes.desc: Small RFC4180-ish CSV parser (quotes only open at field start, like csv-parse's relax mode).

nodes.label: import/parse.ts
nodes.desc: In-app port of packages/importer/src/parse.ts — same logic, but reads the CSVs from an in-memory map (basename → text) extracted from the user's GDPR zip.

nodes.label: import/seed.ts
nodes.desc: In-app port of packages/importer/src/seed.ts + stats.ts — builds the Seed the data sources load, straight from the parsed export (no TMDB required; posters and genres are backfilled lazily by the a…

nodes.label: import/zip.ts
nodes.desc: Minimal ZIP reader for the TV Time GDPR export — zero dependencies.

nodes.label: lib/backend.ts
nodes.desc: Single source of truth for which DataSource + auth mode is active.

nodes.label: moderation.ts
nodes.desc: Moderation & safety client (cloud only): user blocks, content reports, staff actions, account deletion.

nodes.label: notifications.ts
nodes.desc: In-app announcements shown under the bell icon.

nodes.label: posterSweep.ts
nodes.desc: One-shot bulk poster/genre resolver for freshly imported libraries.

nodes.label: pwa.ts
nodes.desc: PWA install support. The `beforeinstallprompt` event fires ONCE early in the page life (Chromium only), so this module is imported for its side effect from _layout and stashes the event for the Set…

nodes.label: ratings.ts
nodes.desc: External ratings, visible in the app (not just links).

nodes.label: rawg.ts
nodes.desc: GamerHoard game-metadata client — reads from the RAWG Video Games Database (https://rawg.io/apidocs).

nodes.label: statsCard.ts
nodes.desc: Shareable stats card — renders a branded 1080x1350 PNG on an offscreen canvas (web only) and hands it to the Web Share API, falling back to a download.

nodes.label: steam.ts
nodes.desc: Steam import for GamerHoard.

nodes.label: theme.ts
nodes.desc: GamerHoard design tokens — dark, cover-forward, cyan + violet accents (gaming vibe).

nodes.label: tmdb.ts
nodes.desc: Compatibility shim. GamerHoard reads game data from RAWG; the real implementation lives in ./rawg.ts. This file keeps the historical import path (`../src/tmdb`) working so screens that haven't been…

nodes.label: index.ts
nodes.desc: Shared domain types + helpers used by the app, importer, and (future) API.

nodes.label: db.ts
nodes.desc: Upsert resolved catalog + a user's tracking into Supabase (service-role).

nodes.label: enrich.ts
nodes.desc: Enrich a seed with poster art.

nodes.label: meta.ts
nodes.desc: Enrich shows with TMDB status + total episodes + genres + network (for categories & stats).

nodes.label: push.ts
nodes.desc: Push a local seed.json into the cloud app_* tables (0003) for one user.

nodes.label: run.ts
nodes.desc: Watch Hoard importer CLI.

nodes.label: seed.ts
nodes.desc: Build a compact, on-device seed from a TV Time export — no cloud, no TMDB required.

nodes.label: tmdb.ts
nodes.desc: Minimal TMDB client. Resolves TheTVDB ids and movie titles -> TMDB posters/metadata. Auth: TMDB v4 read token (TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN) or v3 key (TMDB_API_KEY). Disk-cached.

nodes.label: types.ts
nodes.desc: Normalized shapes the importer produces from a TV Time GDPR export.

nodes.label: steam-auth
nodes.desc: GamerHoard — Steam import backend.
